children: U.S. wholesale inventories grew in August, the Commerce Department said Thursday.
Stocks at wholesale warehouses rose 0.5% in August to $964.2 billion. Analysts polled by The Wall Street Journal were expecting a 0.7% increase.
Sales by wholesalers rose 1.8% month over month in August to $817.5 billion. The inventory-to-sales ratio was 1.18 in August, down from 1.28 a year earlier.
